controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS May 2008 Cassini/Voyager mosaic at 803 m per source pixel (5760 × 2880), resampled into the shared texture layout. No additional detail is created. Coarse polar coverage, source seams and photographed shading remain; gray grid marks explicit no-data. Shared Shadows adds approximate globe lighting. Mean-radius sphere: the real equatorial ridge does not change the silhouette.
controls.title: Multi-mission image mosaic
controls.summary: Polar detail is coarse compared with the rest of the surface. Photographed shadows and seams remain; the grid marks gaps.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 enhanced-color Cassini composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk, with nominal 400 m source pixels. Colors extend into ultraviolet and infrared. The dark leading hemisphere is real surface albedo, not a shadow or missing imagery. All supplied pixels are preserved; coarse patches and residual photographed shading remain. Shared Shadows and globe lighting remain active; shape is approximated by a sphere.
controls.title: Enhanced-color composite
controls.summary: Colors extend into infrared and ultraviolet. The dark leading hemisphere is real surface material, not missing imagery.
